subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-11-14 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 全美航班因空管通信故障停飞；黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO；微软全球宕机致歉
headline_en: FAA grounds all US flights over telecom outage; Jensen Huang steps down at Nvidia; Microsoft apologizes for global disruption

items.title_zh: FAA因通信故障下令全美航班停飞
items.title_en: FAA orders nationwide ground stop over telecom failure
items.body_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）因多个区域航路交通管制中心出现通信问题，下令全美机场暂停航班起飞，这是FAA历史上第三次全国性地面停飞。交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，故障影响全美22个区域航路交通管制中心，已有超过7000架次航班延误或取消。FAA正在调查新部署的AI辅助工具是否与此次故障有关。
items.body_en: The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop after communication issues hit multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers, the third such order in its history. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the failure affected 22 centers, with over 7,000 flights delayed or canceled. The agency is investigating whether a newly deployed AI advisory tool played a role.

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO，市值蒸发超3万亿
items.title_en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; market value evaporates
items.body_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋宣布辞职，结束33年执掌生涯，公司市值随即蒸发超过3万亿元人民币。董事会已聘请外部机构物色继任者，Arm CEO雷内·哈斯和苹果芯片负责人约翰尼·斯鲁吉被列为潜在候选人。黄仁勋的离开也让AI初创公司的融资前景蒙上阴影，风投和创始人预计将面临更小的支票和更低的估值。
items.body_en: Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia CEO after 33 years, wiping more than 3 trillion yuan off the company's market value. The board has hired an outside firm to find a successor, with Arm CEO Rene Haas and Apple silicon chief Johny Srouji among those considered. His departure is also casting a pall over AI startup funding, with VCs and founders bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

items.title_zh: 微软为全球服务中断致歉：网络容量升级引发
items.title_en: Microsoft apologizes for global outage caused by network upgrade
items.body_zh: 微软就持续近24小时的全球服务中断向客户致歉，称故障由一次网络容量升级中的问题引发，与网络攻击或AI无关。Outlook、Teams、OneDrive和Copilot等服务大范围受影响，目前大部分服务已恢复。微软同时表示，没有迹象表明FAA的全国航班停飞与微软服务有关。
items.body_en: Microsoft apologized for a global outage lasting nearly 24 hours, saying the disruption stemmed from a problem in an earlier network capacity upgrade and was not caused by a cyberattack or AI. Services including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and Copilot were widely affected, though most have now recovered. Microsoft also said there is no indication the FAA ground stop is linked to its services.

items.title_zh: LangChain估值达30亿美元，企业客户7000家
items.body_zh: AI智能体初创公司LangChain估值达到30亿美元，其模型和平台无关的智能体管理工具LangSmith已拥有7000家客户。这轮估值反映出企业级AI智能体工具的需求正在快速升温。
items.body_en: AI agent startup LangChain has reached a $3 billion valuation, with 7,000 customers using LangSmith, its model- and platform-agnostic agent management tool. The valuation reflects rapidly growing demand for enterprise AI agent tooling.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Wallet，智能体可代用户付款
items.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases
items.body_zh: OpenAI开始向美国ChatGPT Pro订阅用户推出ChatGPT Wallet，允许其Dots AI智能体代用户完成购买。该功能要求用户年满18岁、使用美国账单地址，并绑定符合条件的美国运通、大通、万事达或Visa卡。
items.body_en: OpenAI is rolling out ChatGPT Wallet to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers, letting its Dots AI agents make purchases on users' behalf. The feature requires users to be 18 or older, have a US billing address and link an eligible US-issued American Express, Chase, Mastercard or Visa card.

items.title_zh: 研究：中国最强AI模型训练用了被禁英伟达芯片
items.title_en: Study: China's top AI models trained on banned Nvidia chips
items.body_zh: 新研究显示，中国最先进的一批AI模型是在被出口禁令限制的英伟达芯片上训练完成的。这一发现可能加剧美国国内围绕芯片出口管制有效性的争论，英伟达此前私下向国会议员确认，技术上可以追踪芯片流向以打击走私。
items.body_en: New research shows that China's most advanced AI models were trained on Nvidia chips subject to export bans. The finding could intensify the US debate over the effectiveness of chip controls; Nvidia has privately told lawmakers that chip tracking is technically feasible to combat smuggling.

items.title_zh: 英伟达丑闻发酵，美财长指责商务部长
items.title_en: Nvidia scandal widens as Treasury chief blames Commerce secretary
items.body_zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特暗示，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克领导的部门未能及时将涉嫌与中国有关联的Megaspeed公司列入实体清单，导致英伟达芯片出口禁令出现漏洞。贝森特对CNBC表示，多个政府机构“数月来一直支持将Megaspeed列入清单”。
items.body_en: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's department failed to promptly add Megaspeed, a firm suspected of China links, to the entity list, leaving a gap in Nvidia chip export controls. Bessent told CNBC that several agencies had favored listing Megaspeed for months.

items.title_zh: 俄罗斯重提北约后撤要求作为乌克兰和平条件
items.title_en: Russia revives demand for NATO pullback in Ukraine peace talks
items.body_zh: 俄罗斯在乌克兰和平谈判中重新提出要求北约从东欧撤军，并据报道要求芬兰退出北约。莫斯科还表示可能与北约成员国缔结互不侵犯条约。这些要求被视为俄方在谈判中加码，欧洲安全议题重新成为焦点。
items.body_en: Russia has revived demands for NATO to pull back from Eastern Europe in Ukraine peace talks, and reportedly asked Finland to leave the alliance. Moscow also said it could conclude non-aggression pacts with NATO members. The demands are seen as an attempt to raise the stakes, putting European security back at the center of negotiations.

items.title_zh: SpaceX将首次尝试同时回收星舰两级
items.title_en: SpaceX to attempt first double catch of Starship
items.body_zh: SpaceX计划在下一次星舰试飞中首次尝试同时用发射塔机械臂抓住超重型助推器和星舰飞船两级。如果成功，这将是可重复使用火箭技术的又一里程碑。
items.body_en: SpaceX will attempt for the first time to catch both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage with the launch tower's arms on its next test flight. Success would mark another milestone in reusable rocket technology.

quick_zh: 波切蒂诺含泪告别美国男足，正式出任曼联主帅。
美国女子冰球队14比0横扫丹麦，创纪录85次射门晋级世锦赛半决赛。
中央气象台发布大雾橙色预警，京津冀等7省市部分地区有浓雾或强浓雾。
quick_en: Mauricio Pochettino tearfully said goodbye to the USMNT and was confirmed as Manchester United manager.
The US women's hockey team routed Denmark 14-0 with a record 85 shots to reach the world championship semifinals.
China's meteorological center issued an orange fog alert for Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and six other provinces.
